title: XPENG North EDSA brings VIPs closer to Anne Curtis and XPENG at official brand launch ahead of October store opening
summary: XPENG North EDSA brought its VIP customers, partners, and invited guests to the official XPENG Philippines Brand Launch at the SM Mall of Asia Arena, giving them an exclusive first-hand experience of…

blocks.text: XPENG North EDSA brought its VIP customers, partners, and invited guests to the official XPENG Philippines Brand Launch at the SM Mall of Asia Arena, giving them an exclusive first-hand experience of the brand’s intelligent electric vehicles ahead of the opening of the XPENG North EDSA flagship store this October.

blocks.caption: XPENG North EDSA brings VIPs closer to Anne Curtis and XPENG at official brand launch ahead of October store opening

blocks.text: One of the highlights of the event was the appearance of Anne Curtis, who joined XPENG in introducing the brand to Filipino audiences and showcased her XPENG L03, giving guests a closer look at the vehicle alongside one of the country’s most recognized personalities.
For XPENG North EDSA’s invited guests, the event went beyond witnessing the official launch. It offered an opportunity to experience the XPENG X9 and L03 up close, discover the brand’s
intelligent technology and premium features, and connect directly with the XPENG North EDSA team for upcoming test drives, pre-orders, and ownership inquiries.
XPENG X9 and L03 Make Their Philippine Debut
At the center of the launch were the XPENG X9 and XPENG L03, two models designed to bring intelligent technology, contemporary design, and a new generation of electric mobility to Filipino customers.

The XPENG X9, a premium seven-seater MPV, combines generous cabin space, comfort, and intelligent technology for families, executives, and customers looking for a premium electric mobility experience.

The XPENG X9 price starts from ₱3,858,000. Meanwhile, the XPENG L03, positioned as a next-generation AI SUV coupe, combines sporty aerodynamic design with advanced intelligent features and a technology-led driving experience.

The XPENG L03 price starts from ₱1,548,000. Both models will be available through XPENG North EDSA, with customers now able to inquire, schedule test drives, and place pre-orders ahead of the store’s official opening.
Test-Drive and Pre-order Privileges Now Available at XPENG North EDSA
Following the official launch, XPENG North EDSA is inviting more customers to experience the X9 and L03 firsthand through its upcoming VIP test-drive program.

Customers interested in XPENG can register with XPENG North EDSA to secure a test-drive opportunity and discover the vehicles’ intelligent features, comfort, technology, and driving experience for themselves.
For customers ready to take the next step, pre-orders for the XPENG X9 and L03 are now open at XPENG North EDSA.
Eligible customers who place a pre-order can receive an exclusive lifestyle gift package worth up to ₱20,000, which includes:
● NEXAL Sports Watch
● Laifen P3 PRO Shaver
● SKG S500 Eye Massager
Each eligible pre-order will receive all three gifts, subject to applicable campaign mechanics and availability.
Early Customers May Unlock More Exclusive XPENG Experiences
Beyond the pre-order package, XPENG North EDSA is also preparing additional exclusive experiences for its early customers.

Customers who register, test drive, or place their orders early may have the opportunity to participate in special XPENG customer activities and future brand experiences involving Anne Curtis, subject to final event arrangements, availability, and campaign mechanics.
Further details will be announced by XPENG North EDSA through its official channels. XPENG North EDSA Store Opening This October
Following the official Philippine brand launch, XPENG North EDSA store is preparing to officially open in October 2026.
Located along the North EDSA automotive and commercial corridor, the dealership will provide customers with a dedicated destination to explore XPENG vehicles, experience the X9 and L03,
book test drives, discuss financing and ownership options, and connect directly with the XPENG North EDSA sales team.
The opening of XPENG North EDSA will mark another step in expanding access to XPENG’s intelligent electric mobility experience in Metro Manila.
Further details regarding the official opening date, opening activities, and upcoming customer events will be announced through XPENG North EDSA’s official social media channels.
Book a Test Drive or Pre-order Your XPENG Today
Customers interested in experiencing the XPENG X9 or L03 do not need to wait for the store opening.
Test-drive registration and pre-orders are now open through XPENG North EDSA.
Customers can visit xrunmotors.com or contact the XPENG North EDSA sales team directly at +63 966 172 8860 for:
Test-drive registration | X9 & L03 inquiries | Vehicle pricing | Pre-orders | Exclusive customer privileges
Customers can also follow and message XPENG North EDSA through its official Facebook, Instagram, and Tiktok accounts for the latest store-opening updates and customer activities.
